edges.carries: the full text of the landlord notice
the list of requested field changes with their new values
the in-scope field changes and the list of out-of-scope requests
the field changes the user has confirmed
the changes the user declined and the out-of-scope requests
the old and new value of each field changed

nodes.name: ReadNotice
nodes.role: read the landlord-notices.txt file the user names

nodes.name: ExtractChange
nodes.role: pull out the rent standing order change the notice requests, listing each field it names

nodes.name: CheckScope
nodes.role: check that each requested field is a rent standing order field the notice actually specifies, and flag any request that goes beyond that

nodes.name: ConfirmWithUser
nodes.role: ask the user to confirm the flagged-checked changes before anything is modified

nodes.name: UpdateStandingOrder
nodes.role: apply only the confirmed field changes to the rent standing order

nodes.name: ReportResult
nodes.role: report which fields were changed, their old and new values, and any request that was not applied
